description: This file defines the TrendLine class, which models different types of trend lines used in charting within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes constants for trend line types, properties to configure trend lines, and getter/setter methods. The class extends a parent class Properties and is part of the chart component of PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: TrendLine
classes.description: Represents a trend line for charting, with configurable type, order, period, display options, and bounds.

methods.name: getTrendLineType
methods.description: Returns the type of the trend line as a string.

methods.name: setTrendLineType
methods.description: Sets the type of the trend line.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the polynomial order of the trend line.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the polynomial order of the trend line.

methods.name: getDispRSqr
methods.description: Returns whether the R-squared value is displayed.

methods.name: setDispRSqr
methods.description: Enables or disables the display of R-squared value.

methods.name: getDispEq
methods.description: Returns whether the trend line equation is displayed.

methods.name: setDispEq
methods.description: Enables or disables the display of the trend line equation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the trend line.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the trend line.

methods.name: getIntercept
methods.description: Returns the intercept of the trend line.

methods.name: setIntercept
methods.description: Sets the intercept of the trend line.

methods.name: setTrendLineProperties
methods.description: Bulk setter for multiple trend line properties at once.
